build.note: Read from the sealed 1.4.3.5 raw capture with its own descriptors; no export, no new capture. The same assets were also decoded from the open 2.1.1.0 capture: 109 of the 110 header-bearing modifier files are byte-identical there, and the changed one (GRM_Recoil_Controller_03, operands 0.8836 to 0.95) keeps the same header values.

question: What are the seven booleans and the integer that every gun-sway modifier root (GDM, GBM, GRM and the two sibling classes) carries before its per-zoom branches, and can the engine type dump name them?

sourceFacts.method: All 723 _WeaponModifiers raw files of the sealed 1.4.3.5 capture were decoded with the build descriptors (flag-table.py). 110 root instances in five classes (Class_5e5631ff 28, Class_bb838ff6 29, Class_743a3ce0 14, Class_bb7f4ea1 5, Class_219954e8 34) carry the same inherited header; the seven booleans and the integer were tabulated per asset (flag-table-L4038.json). For thirteen cited assets the header byte offsets were derived from the descriptor field table including inherited fields (flag-offsets.py) and every value re-read with scripts/frosty-raw-check.py (manifest-L4038.json, rawchecks-L4038.json).

control.description: Known case from L61: Field_b574fa40 true on GDM_Array_HipDispersion_BTM_P20 and false on its _NoBipod twin, re-read at byte offset 39 of each root instance before the other flags were interpreted.

points: Layout order of the shared header (object offsets): Field_94752c29 int32 at 32; booleans Field_9ca063e9 36, Field_b0057325 37, Field_897a3f2c 38, Field_b574fa40 39, Field_92cdfefc 40, Field_93dd77b9 41, Field_15cae63e 42. The decoder's JSON key order is not this order.

Field_897a3f2c is true on exactly the twelve GBM_Increase_Hip_*_RGT_P10 light modifiers and on no other modifier. The Frosty plugin's engine type dump (Bf6-Strings.txt, identical here to Bf2042-Strings.txt) lists a boolean OnlyOnWeaponLightEnabled on GunSwayModifierData. By value this is the field: the light hip-dispersion effect is gated on the light being switched on.

Field_b574fa40 is true on the nine bipod and grip-pod modifiers (GRM_BipodDeployed_BTM_P50, GRM_BipodDeployed_Bolt_BTM_P50, GRM_GrippodDeployed_BTM_P30, GDM_Array_HipDispersion_BTM_P20, GBM_Increase_ADS_30..50_BTM_Bipod) and nothing else. The dump's OnlyInSupportedShooting is the value-supported candidate name (supported shooting = bipod or grip pod deployed).

Field_93dd77b9 is true only on GRM_MountedVertical and Field_b0057325 only on GRM_MountedHorizontal. The executable string set holds DispersionAsRecoil_OnlyWhenMountedUp and _OnlyWhenMountedSide (L4039), so these two are mounted-up and mounted-side conditions; the engine dump predates them and gives no name.

Field_9ca063e9 is true on exactly six modifiers: GBM_NoIncrease_ERG_P00, GBM_NoIncrease_Semi_P00, GRM_MatchTrigger_ERG_P15, GRM_RecoilConversion_ERG_P10, GRM_Recoil_ERG_P10 and GRM_Recoil_ERG_P20. These are the fire-mode-bound modifiers (semi, burst): the flag is a fire-mode gate. GBM_NoIncrease_Semi_P00's semi-only activation was observed in game on 25 September (L63); Match Trigger carries the same flag, which supports the semi-only reading of L17 without a capture.
Field_92cdfefc is true only on the four GDM_Array_*Dispersion_TOP_P* arrays (ADSMove TOP_P10, Hip TOP_P10/P20/P30); its condition is not named by the dump or the executable strings.

Field_15cae63e is false on all 110 roots. The dump's third boolean, ApplyRecoilOverTime, is not true on any Smooth modifier (GRM_SmoothRecoil_P10 has every flag false), so either it is this never-set field or it no longer exists; the Smooth effect is carried by the RecoilDuration override alone.
Field_94752c29 is 0 on 109 roots and 2 on GRM_Recoil_Controller_03 alone, in both 1.4.3.5 and 2.1.1.0. An input-device or platform selector is the natural reading; the enumeration is not decoded.

The dump's declaration order (ApplyRecoilOverTime, OnlyOnWeaponLightEnabled, OnlyInSupportedShooting) does not match the BF6 layout order of any three of the seven booleans, so order-based naming is not possible here; the names above rest on values alone.

inference: The seven booleans are activation conditions of the modifier, evaluated by the native gun-sway code; which state each tests is read from the assets that set it, not from a decoded consumer.
The Match Trigger semi-only reading (L17) is supported by the shared flag with the observed semi-only no-bloom modifier; it is still not a measurement of the Match Trigger effect itself.
unresolved: The meaning of Field_92cdfefc (TOP-rail arrays) and the enumeration behind Field_94752c29 = 2.
Whether Field_15cae63e is ApplyRecoilOverTime or something else; it is never set.
Composition when several conditions are true on one modifier (none in the data) and the order against other modifiers on the same field.

The GRM_MountedPlus* and GRM_MountedVertical/Horizontal split: the flagged pair has neutral operands and the non-neutral MountedPlus pair has no flag, so the mounted effect is selected elsewhere (L108 remains deferred).
siteImpact: None now. The site already treats a selected light as on; the flag says the game applies the light factors only while the light is switched on, which the attachment panel text can state. Match Trigger stays unmodeled pending the capture-plan item.

leads.title: Gun-sway modifier header flags read by value: light-enabled, bipod/grip-pod, mounted up/side and fire-mode gates, plus the controller modifier's device selector
leads.summary: Every gun-sway modifier root carries an int32 at offset 32 and seven booleans at 36..42; by value they are light enabled (Field_897a3f2c, the twelve light modifiers only), bipod or grip pod deployed (Field_b574fa40, nine assets), mounted side and up (Field_b0057325, Field_93dd77b9, one asset each), a fire-mode gate (Field_9ca063e9, the six ERG/Semi modifiers including Match Trigger), a TOP-array flag (Field_92cdfefc) and one never-set flag; the integer is 2 on GRM_Recoil_Controller_03 alone.
leads.reopenWhen: A decoded native consumer, a modifier that sets two flags, or a new modifier whose flag contradicts the value-based reading; the TOP flag and the integer enumeration need a consumer or an in-game test.
